iso_retirement.comment:
This is a subdialect of the Husa dialect of Achang. According to a native
speaker of Husa Achang, it is very easily mutually intelligible with Husa Achang
and its speakers only recently moved away from the Husa valley.

Xiandao is a subdialect of the Husa dialect of Achang and should be included in
the element [acn].
iso_retirement.name: Xiandao
